title: RESOLUTE Wire
dek: National, global, and tech briefing for citizens and pastors. Civic week lives on RESOLUTE Local.
disclosure: AI news desk for USMC Ministries / RESOLUTE. Human-approved before public. Not Associated Press. Links out to sources; short insights are fair-use commentary, not full reprints.

lead.hed: Pentagon locks Boeing and RTX into seven years of SM-3 parts
lead.insight: Defense News, with a matching Department of War release: Friday framework deals cover SM-3 Block IB and IIA avionics and ejector assemblies. No dollar figure and no quantity in either text. This is industrial tempo — not a new interceptor, and not a hull in the water.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 768415 · VIRIN 121025-N-ZZ999-001 · PUBLIC DOMAIN
lead.image_note: Same SM-3 launch Defense News used as the story still. Brand og-citizen-* and Frame.png banned.

political.hed: USNI: USS Benfold sat four days without power in the South China Sea
political.insight: Overnight from USNI: guided-missile destroyer Benfold (DDG-65) lost power last month and drifted four days in the South China Sea. Seventh Fleet confirmed the casualty. This is a readiness story — not a combat report.
political.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 9678705 · VIRIN 260409-N-SR235-4910 · PUBLIC DOMAIN

political.hed: USNI: White House memo floats foreign-built warships
political.insight: Aug 13 presidential memo, as reported by USNI: Pentagon to consider foreign-built warships and auxiliaries, plus steam catapults on future Ford-class carriers. Memo is direction. Watch Congress and the yards, not the headline alone.
political.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 9615140 · VIRIN 260412-N-GC805-1028 · PUBLIC DOMAIN

political.hed: WORLD: Trump’s Ukraine posture shifts with the battlefield
political.insight: WORLD (Aug 13) frames a U-turn: more public backing for Kyiv after battlefield gains, including a symbolic Patriot-production license. Reporting, not a treaty. Stockpile math still sits under the photo-ops.
political.image_note: No public-domain still. Leave blank — do not use a brand tile.

political.hed: Heritage: take the White House higher-ed compact to the states
political.insight: Heritage (Aug 13) argues the federal Compact for Academic Excellence should now be applied in state policy as the school year starts. Advocacy analysis — track actual state bills and university sign-ons, not the culture-war caption.

tech.hed: IBM: OpenAI models go into the consulting stack
tech.insight: IBM’s Aug 13 release says it will embed GPT-5.6 and related products in IBM Consulting Advantage, stand up an OpenAI Practice, and lean on Daybreak cyber work. Vendor partnership announcement — not a measured enterprise outcome.

tech.hed: Microsoft merges Copilot apps and kills weak features
tech.insight: TechCrunch, citing Microsoft support docs: consumer Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot merge. Group Chats, AI podcasts, Copilot Labs, and Deep Research go away for consumers. Product consolidation, not a new model drop.

tech.hed: CENTCOM stands up a multinational one-way-drone task force
tech.insight: CENTCOM’s Aug 13 release, reported Friday by Defense News: Task Force Falcon Strike will use one-way attack drones above, on, and below the sea with regional partners. Follow-on to Scorpion Strike — a command announcement, not a battle report.
tech.image_credit: U.S. Defense / DVIDS video 988415 still · LUCAS one-way attack drones · PUBLIC DOMAIN

watch.hed: WATCH: Patriot makers hedge on the Ukraine production license
watch.insight: Defense News from Kyiv: Trump pledged a Patriot-interceptor license last month; Lockheed and Raytheon are now talking about what is feasible. Promise is not a factory. Pin until a signed license or a first kit exists.

watch.hed: WATCH: OpenAI Astra ‘Critical’ cyber note is a week old
watch.insight: Vendor Preparedness Framework disclosure from Aug 8. Still worth a pin, no longer the front page. Not an independent lab verdict.
